name: Global Weather
overview: Understand temperature, rainfall and wind observations worldwide.
practice: Compare forecast issue times, units and station coverage.

name: Flood Risk
overview: Learn how rainfall, terrain and rivers combine in flood exposure.
practice: Distinguish hazard maps from real-time, official emergency warnings.

name: Cyclones & Storms
overview: Understand storm tracks, intensity and forecast uncertainty.
practice: Always defer to national meteorological agencies for safety alerts.

name: Earthquake Monitoring
overview: Read magnitude, depth and location in event catalogs.
practice: Do not infer imminent earthquakes from historical event patterns.

name: Wildfire Monitoring
overview: Explore hotspots, burn scars and satellite detection limits.
practice: Check acquisition times and possible false positives.

name: Heatwaves
overview: Understand extreme heat indices and public-health impacts.
practice: Compare local heat alerts with official thresholds and guidance.

name: Satellite Imagery
overview: Explore image resolution, revisit cycles and cloud coverage.
practice: Check sensor specifications and licensing before using imagery.

name: Land-cover Change
overview: Understand classification of vegetation, built-up land and water.
practice: Compare harmonized seasons and classification methods.

name: River Erosion
overview: Learn how channel migration affects land and settlements.
practice: Compare imagery across years using consistent georeferencing.

name: Urban Expansion
overview: Analyze changes in built-up footprints over time.
practice: Distinguish construction growth from changes in sensor resolution.

name: Forest Monitoring
overview: Track canopy change, fragmentation and disturbance.
practice: Check whether data represent tree cover or legally defined forest.

name: Crop Vegetation Indices
overview: Understand NDVI and related remote-sensing signals.
practice: Account for cloud cover, soil background and growth stage.

name: Agricultural Drought
overview: Examine rainfall deficit, soil moisture and vegetation stress.
practice: Avoid inferring crop losses from a single indicator.

name: Soil Moisture
overview: Understand surface moisture measurements from satellites.
practice: Review depth, resolution and validation against field conditions.

name: Ground Motion
overview: Learn about satellite radar deformation measurements.
practice: Interpret millimeter-scale trends with uncertainty and local context.

name: Water Quality
overview: Compare parameters such as turbidity, salinity and pH.
practice: Remember remote estimates are not drinking-water safety certification.

name: Groundwater Trends
overview: Understand aquifers, extraction and monitoring wells.
practice: Distinguish measured groundwater levels from modeled estimates.

name: Rainwater Harvesting
overview: Estimate roof catchment potential using rainfall and area.
practice: Include loss factors and appropriate local tank sizing.

name: Ocean Conditions
overview: Explore sea-surface temperature, waves and marine weather.
practice: Read coastal advisories from responsible official agencies.

name: Sea-level Change
overview: Understand long-term sea-level trends and coastal exposure.
practice: Distinguish global mean trends from local relative sea level.

name: Air Quality
overview: Learn AQI components, PM2.5 and monitoring limitations.
practice: Check pollutant basis and aggregation method across countries.

name: Climate Indicators
overview: Explore long-term temperature and precipitation anomalies.
practice: Use a stated baseline period to compare anomalies.

name: Carbon Emissions
overview: Understand sector-level inventories and accounting scopes.
practice: Check territorial versus consumption-based accounting.

name: Biodiversity Maps
overview: Review habitat distributions and species observations.
practice: Distinguish observational gaps from actual species absence.

name: Protected Areas
overview: Explore conservation designations and management context.
practice: Check dates and legal definitions in authoritative datasets.

name: Space Weather
overview: Learn solar storms, geomagnetic activity and potential impacts.
practice: Consult operational warning centers for current conditions.

name: Satellite Tracking
overview: Understand orbits, passes and time-dependent tracking.
practice: Check latest orbital elements and expected tracking errors.

name: Astronomy Events
overview: Plan observations of meteor showers and planetary alignments.
practice: Consider time zones, moonlight and local horizon visibility.

name: Environmental Data Sources
overview: Compare public Earth observation and climate repositories.
practice: Record product versions, resolution, citation and update times.

name: Disaster Preparedness
overview: Review household-level readiness for local hazards.
practice: Follow official instructions rather than a generic website during emergencies.
